record.one_liner: Open-source ecommerce plugin that adds a store, products, orders and customers to WordPress.
record.auth_notes: Keys (Consumer Key/Secret) are generated per WordPress user in WooCommerce settings and sent as HTTP Basic auth over HTTPS. Over plain HTTP, docs require OAuth 1.0a one-legged signing (HMAC key+secret), classed as other. No OAuth 2.0. critic: confirmed.
record.access_notes: Free open-source plugin; store admin generates REST API keys in WordPress admin, no paywall. critic: access confirmed.

evidence.quote: You may use HTTP Basic Auth by providing the REST API Consumer Key as the username and the REST API Consumer Secret as the password.
You must use OAuth 1.0a "one-legged" authentication to ensure REST API credentials cannot be intercepted by an attacker.
